parts.name: Outside Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outside frame of a door set made of wood, forming the structural boundary that supports the door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and alignment for the door, ensuring stability and proper fit within a wall opening.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed component and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door (Left Panel)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left door panel of the door set, made of wood and designed to swing open or closed.
parts.Functional_description: It allows passage through the doorway when opened and provides privacy or security when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the frame, allowing swinging motion.

parts.name: Door (Right Panel)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right door panel of the door set, made of wood and designed to complement the left panel.
parts.Functional_description: It functions similarly to the left door, providing closure and access control.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the frame, allowing swinging motion opposite to the left door.
